cases.situation: I'm a freelance photographer and restaurant owner Luis books me for a menu shoot every season. On Sept 12 I emailed him my new rate, $2,500 a shoot instead of $2,200, and asked about the winter menu shoot; he usually replies within a day but has said nothing. I have dates free in the first two weeks of November.
cases.reply: Hi Luis, bumping my September 12 email in case it got buried. Are you planning a winter menu shoot this year? I have dates free in the first two weeks of November, and the new rate is $2,500 a shoot. A quick yes, no or not this time is all I need.
cases.note: Silence after a rate rise: restate the new rate once, plainly, without apologising for it or discounting in advance, and give an easy no.

cases.situation: 我做餐饮品牌设计，在给火锅店老板赵先生做新菜单，合同已签。9月19号我把排版初稿发过去，说还差菜品照片和最新价格表，十天了他一直没回。菜单要赶10月20号新店开业印出来，我最晚10月9号要拿到资料。
cases.reply: 赵先生您好，菜单排版初稿已经做好了，现在就差两样东西：菜品照片和最新的价格表。照片用手机拍的就可以，先发一部分也行，我先排进去。要赶10月20号开业印出来，我这边最晚10月9号周五要拿到。如果开业时间有变，告诉我一声，我按新的时间调整。
cases.note: 项目卡在客户的资料上时，把要的东西列清楚、降低门槛（手机拍的也行、先发一部分），再给一个倒推出来的日期。

cases.situation: Mandei em agosto uma proposta de site para a clínica veterinária da Dra. Paula e fiz dois follow-ups, sem resposta. Hoje vi que a clínica lançou um site novo, feito por outra agência. Quero encerrar bem, sem ressentimento.
cases.reply: Oi, Dra. Paula, vi o site novo da clínica no ar, parabéns pelo lançamento! Vou encerrar a minha proposta por aqui. Se um dia precisarem de ajuda com o site ou com outro projeto, é só responder este e-mail. Boa sorte com a nova fase!
cases.note: Quando o silêncio era um não, feche sem cobrar explicação nem mostrar mágoa; uma despedida simpática mantém a porta aberta.

cases.situation: Freelance web developer. A dental practice manager, Karen, went silent on my $6,500 quote back in April and I sent a clean close in May. She just emailed asking if we can start next Monday at the April price. The same scope is now $7,200 at my current rates, and my earliest start is Monday 19 October.
cases.reply: Hi Karen, good to hear from you, and I'd be glad to pick this up. My schedule and rates have moved since April, so the quote needs a refresh: the same scope is now $7,200, and the earliest I can start is Monday 19 October. I'll send the updated proposal by Thursday so you have it in writing. Does that timing work on your side?
cases.note: Resurfacing after the close: no reproach for the silence, and re-scope from today's rates and calendar rather than honouring a stale quote.

cases.situation: I'm a copywriter halfway through a 6-page website for a physio clinic. Sent pages 1 to 3 to the owner, Dr. Brennan, on Sept 14 for feedback. Nothing since, and my October is filling up.
cases.reply: Hi Dr. Brennan, a quick one on the website copy: pages 1 to 3 have been with you since September 14, and I'm holding time to finish pages 4 to 6. To keep things on schedule I need your notes by Friday, October 9; if you're happy with them as they are, a one-word "approved" is plenty. If the project has moved down your list, just tell me and I'll pause it and pick it back up when you're ready.
cases.note: Mid-project silence: a real date tied to your schedule, the smallest possible reply, and an explicit pause option.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance developer. Hannah, who runs a boutique hotel, went quiet on my $8,000 booking system proposal for three weeks. Today she replied: 'Sorry for the silence, we've decided to hold off this year.'
cases.reply: Thanks for letting me know, Hannah, I appreciate the clear answer. If it's useful, one line on what tipped it, timing or budget, would help me. Either way, good luck with the hotel, and if the booking system comes back up for 2027, I'd be glad to help.
cases.note: A no after silence is the second-best outcome: thank her, ask one light question, and don't counter with a discount you never offered, which teaches clients that silence gets a better price.

cases.situation: 我是婚礼跟拍摄影师。一对新人陈先生和小雅9月初口头定了11月21号，报价6800，说好月底前付2000定金，之后微信一直没回，我追过一次也没回。现在另一对新人也想约同一天。
cases.reply: 陈先生、小雅，你们好！11月21号那天我一直帮你们留着。现在有另一对新人也想约这一天，所以想跟你们确认一下：如果还定我，麻烦10月2号周五前付一下2000元定金，我就正式锁定档期；如果计划有变或者选了别的摄影师，也完全没关系，回我一句就行，我好把档期放出去。祝筹备顺利！
cases.note: 需要对方在某个日期前做决定时，说清为什么（档期要放出去），给一个具体截止日，并把说“不”变得很容易。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance bookkeeper. My client Omar, who runs two food trucks, went quiet for three weeks on the receipts I need to catch up his July and August books. Today he texted: 'So sorry, crazy month, still want to get this done, what do you need?'
cases.reply: No apology needed, Omar, I know how busy the season gets. To catch up July and August I need two things: the fuel and supplier receipts for both trucks, and the card sales reports for those two months. Phone photos are fine. If I have them by Monday 5 October, your books will be up to date by Friday 9 October.
cases.note: When they come back: skip the reproach, answer 'what do you need' with a short list and a date, and make picking up easy.

cases.situation: I run brand workshops. A bakery owner, Priya, signed and paid a $1,500 deposit on Sept 1 for a half-day workshop. I sent kickoff date options on Sept 8 and nudged once on Sept 15. Nothing since. I have Tuesday 13 and Thursday 22 October free for a 9am to 1pm session at her Main Street shop, and our agreement says the deposit carries over if we reschedule.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, I'd love to get your brand workshop on the calendar before the holiday rush. To keep it simple, here are two options: Tuesday 13 October or Thursday 22 October, both 9am to 1pm at your Main Street shop. Just reply 13 or 22. If this needs to wait until the new year, that's fine too; as our agreement says, your deposit carries over. Just let me know so I can plan.
cases.note: A client who has already paid and gone quiet usually just has too much on: shrink the reply to one word and offer the pause openly.

cases.situation: Ich bin Anna Weber, freiberufliche Übersetzerin. Am 15. September habe ich Frau Krüger, Marketingleiterin bei einem Möbelhersteller, ein Angebot über 3.400 € für die englische Version ihres Herbstkatalogs geschickt. Im Telefonat war sie begeistert, seitdem kam nichts. Ich habe noch nicht nachgehakt.
cases.reply:
Guten Tag Frau Krüger,
ich hole mein Angebot vom 15. September für die englische Fassung Ihres Herbstkatalogs noch einmal nach oben, falls es untergegangen ist. Umfang und Zeitplan passe ich gern an. Wäre ein kurzes Telefonat von 15 Minuten hilfreich, oder klären wir offene Fragen lieber per E-Mail?
Viele Grüße
Anna Weber
cases.note: Erste Nachfrage: davon ausgehen, dass die Mail untergegangen ist, kein Vorwurf, und die Antwort so klein wie möglich machen.

cases.situation: 我做企业宣传片。9月8日给一家茶叶公司的市场部陈经理发了报价，一条3分钟的片子4.8万。15号跟进过一次，没回。上周刚给另一家茶企拍完一条类似的片子，上线一周播放量二十多万。
cases.reply: 陈经理您好，上周我们刚给另一家茶企做完一条类似的3分钟宣传片，上线一周播放量二十多万，想着也许对您有参考价值，片子我附在这条消息后面。想问一下，宣传片今年还在计划里吗？回我一句“在做”“不做了”或者“晚点再说”就行。
cases.note: 第二次跟进要带点新东西，并把问题缩小到一句话就能回答；再没回音，两周后礼貌收尾。

cases.situation: I'm Marco Ruiz and I run Clearline Cleaning, a commercial cleaning company; my number is 555 0148. I sent Dana, facilities manager for a dental group with four clinics, a $3,800/month proposal on Sept 1, then followed up twice by email. Nothing. I have her direct line and want to leave one voicemail as my last touch.
cases.reply: Hi Dana, it's Marco Ruiz from Clearline Cleaning, on 555 0148. I'm calling about the cleaning proposal for your four clinics that I sent on September 1. I don't want to keep filling your inbox, so this is my last follow-up. If it's still on your list, a quick call back or a one-line email is all I need; if the timing's wrong, no need to call, and I'll close it on my side. Again, Marco, 555 0148. Thanks.
cases.note: Switching to voicemail for the close: name and number at both ends, one line on what it's about, and offer the no so she doesn't have to call to say it.

cases.situation: I'm Lena Park, a freelance illustrator. I sent Megan, marketing lead at Pine & Pillar Coffee, a $2,800 quote for artwork on their seasonal bag range on Sept 3 and bumped it once. No reply, and today LinkedIn says she left the company last month. Her replacement is Jordan Reyes, who has never heard of me.
cases.reply: Hi Jordan, congratulations on the new role at Pine & Pillar. I'm Lena Park, an illustrator; before she left, Megan and I were discussing new artwork for your seasonal bag range, and I've attached the $2,800 quote I sent her on 3 September so you have the context. I know you've inherited a lot, so no pressure: is packaging art still on the plan for this season? A quick yes, no or not yet is all I need.
cases.note: When your contact has left, the silence wasn't about you: start fresh with the new person, give the context in one line, and keep the reply to one word.

cases.situation: 我给一家瑜伽馆做小红书代运营，包月3,000元，9月的钱已经付了。但从8月底开始，老板娘Coco就没再回过我发的内容排期，连着5周没审。10月的排期我已经做好了，但不敢擅自发。
cases.reply: Coco你好，10月的内容排期我已经做好了，想跟你确认接下来怎么安排：1是你不用逐条审，我按排期直接发，有问题随时叫停；2是先暂停，等你忙完再接上。回我“1”或“2”就行。10月9号周五前没收到回复的话，我先暂停发布，等你消息。
cases.note: 包月客户长期沉默：把回复缩成一个数字，并说清楚没回复时你会怎么做；暂停期间费用怎么算，以合同为准，另外单独说。

cases.situation: Soy consultora de marketing. Andrés, dueño de tres panaderías, agendó una videollamada conmigo para el lunes 28 a las 10 y no se conectó. Le escribí ese mismo día y no ha contestado.
cases.reply: Hola, Andrés: imagino que el lunes se complicó el día, con tres panaderías es lo más normal. Si todavía te interesa hablar del marketing de las tiendas, te propongo dos opciones de 20 minutos: jueves 8 de octubre a las 10 o viernes 9 a las 16. Contéstame solo «jueves» o «viernes». Y si ahora no es buen momento, un «ahora no» también me sirve y lo dejo aquí.
cases.note: Un plantón no es un rechazo: sin reproches, dos horarios concretos y una salida fácil. Si no responde, un mensaje de cierre en dos semanas.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance landscape designer. I quoted Mr. Hollis $9,500 for a back garden redesign on Aug 28; he asked for something cheaper, so on Sept 10 I sent a $6,800 version without the pergola. I bumped it once on Sept 17 and nothing since. I'm tempted to offer $6,000 just to get a reply.
cases.reply: Hi Mr. Hollis, following up on the $6,800 version of the garden redesign I sent on September 10, the one without the pergola. Is the redesign still something you'd like to do this year? A quick yes, no or not yet is all I need. If the budget is the sticking point, tell me which part of the plan matters most to you and I'll price that part on its own.
cases.note: Don't cut the price to break the silence, it teaches clients that going quiet gets a discount; shrink the scope, not the rate.

cases.situation: 我做企业培训，9月初给一家物流公司的HR王经理发了新员工培训方案，跟进了两次都没回，上周发了收尾的消息说先不打扰了。今天她回我：“我们这边还在内部讨论，你不用一直催。”
cases.reply: 明白，王经理，打扰了。您那边定下来之前我就不再跟进了。等有结果，不管做不做，直接回这条消息就好，我这边随时可以配合。
cases.note: 对方带点情绪时不解释、不辩护，把节奏交还给她；这时候再追才真的伤关系。

cases.situation: I'm Rosa, a freelance event planner. On Sept 14 Imogen, HR lead at a 60-person software firm, said yes on a call to me planning their holiday party on Friday Dec 11 for $6,000. I sent the contract on Sept 16 and bumped it once on Sept 23; it's still unsigned, and the venue will only hold the date until Friday Oct 9.
cases.reply: Hi Imogen, I'm still holding the venue for your holiday party on Friday 11 December, and their hold ends on Friday 9 October. To keep it, I'd need the signed contract by Thursday 8 October. If something in it needs changing, point me to it and I'll turn it round the same day; if plans or budget have shifted, just say so and I'll release the date.
cases.note: A verbal yes with an unsigned contract: a real outside deadline, a quick fix for whatever is blocking it, and an easy no. Don't start booking suppliers until it's signed.

cases.situation: I make handmade ceramic mugs. At a gift trade fair on Aug 30 I met Chloe, who owns a homeware shop, and on Sept 3 I sent her six sample mugs; she said she'd put them out and see how they sold. I bumped her by Instagram DM on Sept 14, nothing since. I've just dropped my wholesale minimum from 24 mugs to 12.
cases.reply: Hi Chloe, one update since the samples: I've dropped my wholesale minimum from 24 mugs to 12, which might make a first order easier to test. Are the mugs something you'd like to stock this season? A quick yes, no or not yet is all I need.
cases.note: Touch 2: real news as the reason to write, and a one-word way to say no.

cases.situation: 我是做品牌设计的，在给一家烘焙店的老板娘林姐做Logo，9月10号把第二版发过去后她就没回了。后来听共同朋友说，她父亲8月底住院了。我想发一条不给她压力的消息。
cases.reply: 林姐，听说叔叔住院了，希望他早日康复。Logo的事您完全不用着急，我这边先暂停，等您方便了回这条消息，我们就接着做。要是想换个时间或者先不做了，也直接说一声就好。
cases.note: 知道对方家里有事时，不催进度，主动暂停，把什么时候继续交给她决定。

cases.situation: 大阪でフリーランスのWebデザイナーをしている山田彩です。8月20日に和菓子店「松風堂」の鈴木さんへホームページ制作の見積もり（45万円）を送り、9月3日と9月17日にフォローしましたが返事がありません。断りにくいのだと思うので、角を立てずに区切りをつけたいです。
cases.reply:
鈴木様
いつもお世話になっております。8月20日にお送りしたホームページ制作のお見積もりの件、今はタイミングではないのだと受け止め、こちらではいったん区切りとさせていただきます。ご検討いただき、ありがとうございました。またホームページのお話が出てきた際は、このメールにご返信いただければすぐに対応いたします。松風堂様のますますのご繁盛をお祈りしております。
山田 彩
cases.note: はっきり断りにくい相手には、こちらから区切る一通が一番親切。返事がなくても、それ以上は追わない。

cases.situation: I'm a piano teacher. On Sept 17 I told Mrs. Adeyemi that her son Tobi isn't ready for his Grade 3 exam in November and suggested waiting until March. Tobi still comes on Thursdays, but she hasn't replied, and I need to know by Wednesday Oct 7 whether to enter him for March.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs. Adeyemi, I know my message on September 17 about moving Tobi's Grade 3 exam to March probably wasn't what you hoped to hear. If you see it differently, I'd really like to hear why, and I'm happy to talk it through for ten minutes after one of his Thursday lessons. Either way, could you let me know by Wednesday 7 October whether you'd like me to enter him for March? A quick yes, no or let's talk is all I need.
cases.note: Silence after news they didn't want: name it lightly, invite disagreement instead of defending yourself, and still ask for the one decision you need.

cases.situation: I'm a dog trainer. On Sept 15 I did a free assessment for Leo and his reactive collie, Pepper, and on Sept 16 I emailed him a 6-session package for $480; I bumped it on Sept 23 and heard nothing. Since then I've written a one-page guide to walking reactive dogs at quieter times, which I now give all my clients.
cases.reply: Hi Leo, I've just put together a one-page guide to walking reactive dogs at quieter times, and I thought it might help with Pepper whatever you decide, so it's attached. Is training still something you're looking at this autumn? A quick yes, no or not yet is all I need.
cases.note: Touch 2: give something useful with no strings and shrink the ask to one word; no discount.

cases.situation: 我叫陈晨，我们小团队给一家连锁药店做会员小程序，合同已签、首款已付。对接人周经理9月10日收到需求确认稿后就没回过，我微信和邮件各追了两次。要赶11月上线，10月9日前必须拿到确认。签约那天他们的刘总也在，加了我微信，说有事可以直接找他。我想联系刘总，但不想让周经理难堪。
cases.reply: 刘总您好，我是做会员小程序的陈晨。想跟您同步一下进度：需求确认稿9月10日发给了周经理，目前还没有定下来。为了赶11月上线，我们需要在10月9日周五前拿到确认。您看是由周经理确认，还是您这边指定一位同事来对接？如果项目需要先缓一缓，也直接告诉我，我们好调整排期。
cases.note: 越过对接人时只讲事实和日期，不评价他，把问题变成“谁来确认”；最好先跟周经理说一声你会同步刘总。

cases.situation: Je suis graphiste freelance. Le 8 septembre, j'ai envoyé à M. Garnier, gérant d'une cave à vin, la version finale de son logo après deux allers-retours, et je l'ai relancé le 17 septembre, sans réponse. Mon contrat prévoit le solde de 900 € à la validation finale, et j'ai envie d'écrire « sans retour d'ici vendredi, je considère le logo validé et j'envoie la facture ».
cases.reply: Bonjour Monsieur Garnier, je reviens vers vous au sujet de la version finale du logo envoyée le 8 septembre. Pour clôturer le projet, j'ai besoin de votre validation : un simple « validé » en réponse suffit, ou vos dernières remarques si un détail vous gêne encore. Dès votre accord, je vous envoie les fichiers définitifs et la facture du solde de 900 €, comme prévu au contrat. Et si le projet doit attendre, dites-le-moi, je le mets en pause sans problème.
cases.note: Le silence n'est pas une validation : demandez un oui explicite et proposez la pause plutôt que de facturer par défaut.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance translator, and Ms Lindqvist, who runs a small travel agency, has sent me work every month for a year. The brochure I delivered on September 18 had a wrong price on page 2; she caught it, I fixed it the same day and apologised, and since then I've added a second read-through of every figure before delivery. She hasn't replied or sent anything since, and I have space the week of October 12.
cases.reply: Hi Ms Lindqvist, I wanted to check in after the brochure on September 18. The price error on page 2 was my mistake, and since then I've added a second read-through of every figure before anything goes out. I have space the week of October 12 if anything is coming up. And if that brochure left you with doubts, I'd rather hear it directly; a quick reply either way is all I need.
cases.note: Silence after your own mistake: name it once with the fix, don't grovel, and make it easy for her to say what's really going on.

cases.situation: I'm Nadia, an agency recruiter. My client Halverson Foods interviewed my candidate Ben for their finance manager role on 17 September, and their hiring manager, Graham, has ignored two emails asking for feedback. Ben has another offer he must answer by Thursday 8 October, and he's happy for me to tell Graham that Halverson is his first choice.
cases.reply: Hi Graham, a time-sensitive one on Ben for the finance manager role: he has another offer to answer by Thursday 8 October, and Halverson is his first choice. Could you let me know by Wednesday 7 October whether you'd like to move him forward? A quick yes, no or not yet is all I need, and if it's a no, one line of feedback would really help him. If the role is on hold, just say so and I'll tell him.
cases.note: A real outside deadline gives a silent client a reason to answer; share the candidate's preference only with his say-so.

cases.situation: 我们公司给一家律所做IT运维外包，年度合同10月31日到期，合同写续约需要双方书面确认。9月15日我把续约报价（每月8000元，和今年一样）发给了行政主管何姐，9月24日跟进过一次，都没回。如果不续，我们需要至少两周时间把账号、密码和设备资料整理好交接。
cases.reply: 何姐您好，咱们的运维合同10月31日到期，9月15日发您的续约报价是每月8000元，和今年一样。为了不影响所里的日常运转，想请您在10月16日（周五）前回我一句：续约、不续，或者需要再谈都行。如果不续也完全没关系，我们会用最后两周把账号、密码和设备资料整理好，完整交接给您指定的人。没收到书面确认，我们不会默认续约，10月16日我再打个电话跟您确认。
cases.note: 老客户续约前沉默：给一个倒推出来的日期，让三种回答都容易说出口；合同要求书面确认，沉默不等于续约。

cases.situation: I'm Jo, a massage therapist. Gwen came in for a monthly back massage for two years, but her last visit was in June, and she hasn't rebooked or answered the one text I sent in August. From Monday 2 November I'm moving to a new studio on Elm Street, with Saturday morning slots for the first time.
cases.reply: Hi Gwen, Jo here. A quick bit of news in case it's useful: from Monday 2 November I'm moving to a new studio on Elm Street, and for the first time I'll have Saturday morning slots. If a monthly massage still fits your life, I'd be glad to see you again; if it doesn't right now, no need to reply, and I won't keep texting. Take care.
cases.note: A regular who drifts away doesn't owe you an explanation: real news, an easy no, and this is the last nudge unless she replies.

cases.situation: 我们公司做餐厅排队点餐系统，给一家连锁面馆的运营负责人孙总三家门店免费试用了30天，9月30日试用结束。试用期间每周发的数据报告他一次都没回，最后一周三家店的平均排队时间从18分钟降到了11分钟。正式版每店每月600元，试用账号10月9日关闭。
cases.reply: 孙总您好，三家门店的30天试用9月30日已经结束了，最后一周平均排队时间从18分钟降到了11分钟。想问一下您接下来的打算：继续用（每店每月600元）、不用了，或者还想再看看，回一句就行。试用账号会保留到10月9日周五，没收到您的确认，我们不会自动转成正式版收费。
cases.note: 试用结束后的沉默：用一个真实数据做理由，给三个都容易说出口的回答，并说清没回复时不会默认收费。

cases.situation: I'm Hugo and I run a two-person IT security consultancy. On 3 September I sent Ms Farah, practice manager at a 40-person accountancy firm, a £14,000 proposal for a security audit, and she said the partners would decide at their meeting on Thursday 24 September. I've heard nothing since, and I can start the audit the week of Monday 19 October.
cases.reply: Hi Ms Farah, I know the partners were due to discuss the security audit proposal at their meeting on 24 September, so I wanted to ask how it landed. If it's a go, I can start the week of Monday 19 October. If they'd like changes to the scope, just tell me which part and I'll revise it; and if it's a no or not this year, a one-line reply is plenty. Best, Hugo
cases.note: When they named a decision point, follow up on that event: it gives a natural reason to write and makes yes, change or no equally easy to send.
